datasets.title: Historical own scoring plus ball security, 1997-2026
datasets.description: Research player-season surface for own scoring plus ball security, with two labeled research groups: playtype_mix_rapm (two-season TD550 lineup playtype-mix value, pts/100, positive = easier diet) and the lineup_*tov* columns (two-season TD550 lineup turnover split into own, teammate and unassigned team turnovers, priced in pts/100, positive = fewer turnovers). It is not total offense, playmaking, ORAPM, VPM, or production rZTOV, and no research column is ever added to zTS, SV/100, turnover value, or scoring security.

metadata.playtype_mix_rapm: Full parent playtype-mix value (own + teammate diet) from the two-season, 550-day half-life lineup solve, 1997-2026; pts/100, positive = easier lineup shot diet. Descriptive research only, ungated at this spec (the TD700 predecessor failed the future-oTS increment test); blank where no solve, never zero.
metadata.lineup_tov: Transparency view of what time-decayed lineup data implies about turnovers with the player on offense: saved turnovers per 100 from a two-season, 550-day half-life joint O/D ridge (3000/5000) on season-centred attributed and unassigned scoring/bad-pass turnovers, split own=(parent+4c)/5 and teammates=4(parent-c)/5 with a CV-chosen focal contrast, priced at the TD-weighted non-turnover first-chance net value. Lineup own is measured against a flat one-fifth share, not the box workload allowance. Team turnovers are absent from 1997-2013 source rows (lineup_team_tov_coverage). Descriptive research only; blank where no solve, never zero.

datasets.title: Two-season TD550 playtype-mix RAPM board, 1997-2026
datasets.description: Research-only time-decayed lineup playtype-mix RAPM, one solve per feature season over that season and the prior one at a 550-day half-life: how hard the shot diet is while a player is on court, split exactly into the player's own shots and teammates' shots. Positive mix_rapm means a harder diet; positive value100 means an easier one. Not zTS, VPM, or a prior.

metadata.units: mix_rapm on the TS-point scale, 50 x lag-priced expected points per FGA (positive = harder); value100 in points per 100 possessions (positive = easier)
metadata.history_caveat: 1997 has history_seasons=1 and prices its shot mix on itself (no 1996 raw file); every later season has history_seasons=2. SELF_CREATED_3 is almost never tagged before 2009, so early own/teammate splits read the descriptor regime as well as the diet.
metadata.promotion_status: diagnostic-only and ungated at this spec; the TD700 predecessor's future-oTS increment was -0.0040 [-0.0233,+0.0136]
metadata.spec: window_seasons=2, half_life_days=550, alphas off/def/role 3000/5000/10000, lag-priced difficulty

datasets.title: Two-season TD550 lineup turnover board, 1997-2026
datasets.description: Research-only time-decayed lineup turnover RAPM, one solve per feature season over that season and the prior one at a 550-day half-life: team turnovers per 100 avoided with the player on offense, split exactly into own, teammate and unassigned team turnovers for the scoring and bad-pass lanes, plus unadjusted on-court raw rates and a point-priced value. Not rZTOV, not a prior, not VPM.

metadata.units: *_saved100 in turnovers per 100 of the player's offensive possessions (positive = fewer turnovers); *_value100 in points per 100
metadata.identity: lane total = own + teammate + unassigned; own = (parent_attributed + 4*contrast)/5; teammate = 4*(parent_attributed - contrast)/5; lineup_tov_saved100 = scoring + bad-pass totals; value = saved * tov_point_price
metadata.team_tov_coverage: absent 1997-2013 (Gabriel source rows omit team-actor turnovers), partial 2014, full 2015+
metadata.spec: window_seasons=2, half_life_days=550, parent alphas off/def 3000/5000, role-contrast alpha 300 (grouped-game CV, one-SE)
